The model proposed in this paper contains key information about a system, such as requirements, structure, behavior, and analysis. This model-based approach for CubeSat subsystems helps to visualize and understand what is needed for the design of a CubeSat power subsystem, while guaranteeing that the designers are clearly aware of which requirements are being met and which are not.

For over 10 years, the INCOSE Space Systems Working Group (SSWG) Challenge Team has conducted research into the applicability of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) to build a CubeSat design model [6]. This team has focused on the elaboration of a sufficiently complete CubeSat System Reference Model (CSRM) that can be adapted to any CubeSat project and so far more than 20 research papers have been published by this working group [7]

Therefore, the current paper aims to expand on the previous work done within the SSWG, while proposing a modeling methodology for a MBSE approach to CubeSat design, to guarantee traceability early from the conceptual stage. The traceability enabled by data integration can contribute to automating the design optimization of CubeSats and allow for the early detection of potential design errors.
